text: Hello, sorry its the middle of the night. Im a foster carer and Ive got a little boy staying with me, hes 3, been with us about a month. Since yesterday afternoon hes been pulling at his left ear on and off and tonight he told me 'ear hurty' which is the first time hes actualy said it. Hes had a temprature on and off as well, I didnt write the numbers down which I know I shoud have, sorry Im running on about two hours sleep. Ive been giving him calpol and then ibuprofen when its due and in between the doses hes honestly fine, playing with his cars, drinking his juice and water no problem, chatting away to me non stop about diggers. Its just when the medicine wears off he gets grizzly again and goes for the ear. I need to let the social worker know whatever happens so I wanted to check with someone if this can wait for the GP in the morning or if theres anything else I shoud be doing tonight. Thanks and sorry for the essay
